about_the_game:
After the events of the first game, the faceless detective Igor has become a liability to the system. His actions, overly personal insights, and operations beyond the organization’s protocol have become grounds for dismissal. Now, they plan to send him back to the Foundation — a covert structure hidden from society, where entities like him are trained into government service. Only this time, he’s meant to stay there forever.

You’ll once again take on the role of the faceless — a telepath capable of sensing the auras of others, yet understanding himself less and less. Escape the system in search of a freer life, one not locked behind four walls. Give Igor a chance at a normal life!

Gameplay:

  • A pixel-art side-scrolling adventure with nonlinear exploration and a deep dialogue system.

  • Interact with characters through dialogue choices, contextual decisions, and moral dilemmas.

  • Use your PPC (Pocket Personal Computer) to analyze unclean entities, find clues, and store information.

Features:

  • Explore a dysfunctional secret reservation, unlike anything you’ve seen before.

  • Colorful characters with their own fates, ideas, and goals.

  • Subtle satire and paradoxical humor, inspired by post-Soviet aesthetics, Slavic mythology, and absurdism.

  • Branching dialogues and a developing protagonist, whose identity is shaped by your actions.

  • Random anomalies, parallel realities, and time loops.

The Devilry Reservation 2 is not just a sequel — it’s a descent: into a world where monsters reflect your nature; into a lie elevated into a system; and into the darkest corners of the self, where questions are more terrifying than the answers.

short_description: Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of Slavic folklore and post-Soviet aesthetics. Escape the system, seek the truth among half-forgotten myths and urban legends. In this madness, every clue is part of someone else’s game, and your past is the greatest mystery.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Simplified Chinese, Norwegian, Russian, Finnish, Swedish, Japanese, Italian, Polish
